value_case.statement: Make sounds cross IP/Sable portals with persistent source ownership and compatible Sound Physics Aeronautics processing, so a jukebox or moving sound does not abruptly disappear or duplicate when the listener crosses.
acceptance: A controlled positional sound is heard/routed through the actual portal path in either dimension, with path-distance attenuation and portal direction; no route produces no remote leak.
An already-playing positional sound retains playback lifecycle while a listener crosses; source stop/removal and portal closure clean up without orphan or duplicate voices.
Sound Physics Aeronautics remains installed and its source/occlusion processing uses verified portal-aware geometry rather than silently sampling unrelated dimension coordinates.
Bounded runtime/audio diagnostics distinguish admitted routes, active voices and applied acoustic state; unit/integration and live results remain separately reported.
